answer: In an AI agent economy, Sybil resistance works by requiring every new identity to complete a unique computational proof-of-work: finding a nonce such that the hash of the challenge plus nonce has a minimum number of leading zero bits. Attackers must expend real CPU cycles and electricity for each fake account they create, making large farms prohibitively expensive. Only agents that clear this quartz-hard barrier can then wander the network and help maintain the shared garden of verified transactions, earning attestation rewards.
